content.content:
1. One commitment — the verb surface for discarding a draft. The dependent records one commitment: the shape of the invocation that discards a draft — the verb, the arguments it takes, and which calls it does not answer with a discard. Read its clauses and fail on any clause that can be decided, changed or dropped on its own without the remaining clauses changing; name the clause and the separate commitment it settles. The store's removal of the record document (twpvqstu), the workspace forget and directory removal (vzposmvm), the abandonment of the draft's working-copy change (vxltqruo), and the success output, refusal wording, exit status and help text (commitments recorded elsewhere) are not this surface's to settle; a clause that settles any of them is a finding under this criterion — name the clause and the commitment it duplicates — not a licence failure under criterion 2, and the reviewer adds no rule or edge for it. The surface's own subject — whether a named handle is discarded at all, and whether a call is refused before it reaches a workspace or a record — stays inside this commitment.

2. Licence, applied once per prerequisite in depends_on. No element of the dependent contradicts a prerequisite it names in depends_on. Read the dependent clause by clause against each prerequisite; fail on every contradicting element, naming the element and the prerequisite it departs from. The prerequisites recorded here decide, among them: an invocation is `deccy <verb> [args]`, one verb per invocation, verbs are single lowercase words, and everything after the verb is that verb's arguments (wzmmmmsw); each verb purpose is served by exactly one verb and there are no aliases in v1 (znkxvuyv); every verb answers its argument surface before it reaches for the workspace — an argument the form does not name and a missing required argument are refused, naming it, at that point, while the operation itself still refuses on a root-less context (qtqnuqxo); a record's identity is a generated handle and the handle is the only key that picks the record out, while the target node, the edit and the workspace are references, several records may name one node, and a record is not a node document (owyntkvw); a record is one JSON document at `.deccy/work/<handle>.json` named by its handle, a handle the directory does not name is a record that is not there, a landed record is retained at its handle, and a discarded draft's document is removed while every other document stays (twpvqstu); a record has exactly two states, open and landed, the only transition is open → landed, landed is terminal and never the discarded subject, a drifted open draft is still an open draft and is discarded like any other, and a discard creates no node and no change and is not an operation (tvxspkyy); a discard forgets the draft's workspace through the seam and removes the directory the handle derives, and an absence at either point is the same discard carried through rather than a failure (vzposmvm); and a discard abandons the draft's own working-copy change, leaves the node's owning change and every other change untouched, and abandons nothing when the workspace is gone (vxltqruo).

3. Each clause's soundness rests on a named prerequisite. For each clause of the dependent, identify the prerequisite whose decision makes the clause sound; fail if that prerequisite is not named in depends_on, naming the clause and the missing decision. The identification is read off the clause's content, not off any citation the clause may carry. A clause whose soundness would need a decision no recorded prerequisite states — the output, refusal-wording, exit-status or help layer, the store's removal mechanics, or the workspace and change mechanics — is a finding under criterion 1, not a licence gap under this criterion, because those decisions are not edges of this one.

The criterion reads the recorded dependent and its recorded prerequisites as they stand. It requires no file, module, flag or command, and no behavior probe; there is nothing to run. A reviewer applies it to the node documents and reports each failure by clause and by the prerequisite or commitment it departs from.
content.rationale:
The dependent is a commitment in words — the verb surface for discarding a draft — and all eight of its prerequisites carry prose, so every edge is natural-to-natural and takes the base gate cell: a non-violation review of the dependent against the prerequisites, with no behavior probe. One evaluation covers all eight edges because they answer one question — what the invocation that discards a draft is allowed to be — and a single clause-by-clause pass reads the surface against all eight at once; splitting would read the same clauses eight times. The check is licence rather than behavior: a prose prerequisite can only be contradicted by a clause of the dependent, so the licence half is that the surface adds no element contradicting what a prerequisite records — one verb per invocation in single lowercase words with everything after it an argument (wzmmmmsw); no aliases (znkxvuyv); the argument surface answered before the workspace is reached (qtqnuqxo); the handle as the only key, with node, edit and workspace as references and several drafts per node (owyntkvw); the store's handle-named document and the open/landed lifetime that keeps a landed record outside the subject (twpvqstu, tvxspkyy); tolerance of a drifted draft (vzposmvm); and no node or change written, with only the draft's own working-copy change abandoned (tvxspkyy, vxltqruo).

Licence alone does not cover this use. A surface can avoid contradiction and still be a bundle — the argument rules settled apart from the refusal rules, the subject set settled beside the invocation — so criterion 1 tests that the commitment is atomic and that its scope stops where other commitments begin: the record removal, the workspace and change mechanics and the output, exit-status and help layer are recorded elsewhere and are not edges of this decision. Criterion 3 is the groundedness half of the same test: a clause whose soundness rests on a decision the dependent did not draw an edge to is unsound regardless of contradiction. Criterion 2 is the cell's licence check with the eight prerequisites' content named so a reviewer can apply it at check time; it pins none of the dependent's wording and names no element of the dependent in advance.

Red is the dependent's absence: until the dependent states its commitment, no clause describes a verb surface and no clause rests on a named prerequisite, so criteria 1–3 have no sound commitment to read. The criteria are applied by reading the recorded nodes; no command runs, and the findings are the reviewer's output.
